description: This file defines a React component 'MarkdownContent' that renders Markdown content with customizable styling and plugin support. It uses 'react-markdown' and 'remark-gfm' to parse and display Markdown with extended features. The component supports various Markdown elements with specific styling and some utility functions for class names.
